verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no documented way to set up background automations that run on their own, such as scheduled, recurring or unattended agent tasks. The AI Agent and the MCP Server both work interactively inside an open editor session, and the AI Agent acts when you describe what you want. Webhooks and the Real-time API 'automate responses' only as event-driven interactivity inside a scene, which is an adjacent feature rather than autonomous background automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
